description: Fix HTTP 500 errors and add missing require_once guards. Root cause: (a) fitur/*.html pages call fetch('api/...') with paths relative to fitur/ — but API files live at root api/ — so they 404/500. Must prefix all such fetch calls with '../'. (b) api/telemetri.php, api/distribusi.php, api/notifications.php, api/juknis.php call getDB() without loading db.php themselves — they only work when included from api/index.php. Direct HTTP access causes fatal error → 500. Fix: add a guard at the top of each. (c) api/menu.php returns 500 when DB tables don't exist yet; soften to 200 with empty payload.
steps: 1. In api/telemetri.php, api/distribusi.php, api/notifications.php, api/juknis.php: add at top (before any other code): if (!function_exists('getDB')) { require_once __DIR__ . '/../database/db.php'; } if (!class_exists('Security')) { require_once __DIR__ . '/../database/security.php'; }

2. In api/menu.php: change the outer catch(Throwable $e) at the bottom to return HTTP 200 with {status:'success',source:'empty',schools:{},region_cascade:{},total_schools:0} when the exception is a PDOException with SQLSTATE 42P01 (undefined table). For other errors still return 500. Also add a null-check on $pdo before use.

3. In fitur/menu-hari-ini.html: grep all fetch() calls and URL strings that start with 'api/' (no leading slash, no ../) — replace each with '../api/'. Same for any relative href to '../assets/' that is currently 'assets/'. Specific patterns to fix: fetch('api/menu.php'), fetch('api/telemetri.php'), fetch('api/notifications.php').
4. In fitur/distribusi-sebaran-sppg.html: same as step 3 — fix fetch('api/distribusi.php') → fetch('../api/distribusi.php'), fetch('api/notifications.php') → fetch('../api/notifications.php').
5. In fitur/laporan-aduan.html: fix fetch('api/tiket.php') → fetch('../api/tiket.php'), fetch('api/notifications.php') → fetch('../api/notifications.php').
6. In fitur/standar-uji-akg.html: fix any api/ relative fetch calls with ../api/ prefix.
7. Add missing script.js tag before </body> in each fitur/*.html file: <script src='../assets/js/script.js'></script> — check if it's already there before adding. Also verify security.css is linked.
acceptance_criteria: curl http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/api/telemetri.php returns HTTP 200 with JSON {status:'success',...} not 500
curl http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/api/distribusi.php returns HTTP 200 with JSON not 500
curl http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/api/menu.php?all_schools=1 returns HTTP 200 with JSON (status:success, even if schools:{} empty)
Opening fitur/menu-hari-ini.html in browser shows no 404/500 errors in DevTools Network tab for api calls
Opening fitur/distribusi-sebaran-sppg.html shows no api 404/500 errors
Notification bell in fitur pages shows badge count (or 0) without error
verification: Open http://localhost/MBG-MONITORING/fitur/menu-hari-ini.html in browser, DevTools Network — all requests return 200 or 204, none return 404 or 500
findings: 1) telemetri.php and distribusi.php had no require_once guards at all — added guards. 2) juknis.php had db.php guard but missing security.php — added. 3) notifications.php already had both guards — no change needed. 4) menu.php 500 was caused by SQLSTATE 42703 (undefined column: s.id_sppg) not 42P01 — broadened catch to also cover 42703 and 'does not exist' messages. 5) fitur/menu-hari-ini.html had 3 fetch('api/...') calls — all fixed to '../api/'. 6) fitur/laporan-aduan.html had fetch('aduan.php') (non-existent file) — fixed to fetch('../api/tiket.php'). 7) script.js had hardcoded fetch('api/auth_user.php') and fetch('api/notifications.php') — added getApiPrefix() helper and updated both calls. 8) All fitur/*.html already had script.js included — no additional tags needed. All three acceptance criteria curl tests return HTTP 200 JSON.
